				}
				prestige >= 50
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
			location:oxford = {
				change_development = 2
				change_control = control_mild_bonus
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_bri_most_esteemed_university_modifier years = -1 }
			}
			location:cambridge = {
				change_development = 2
				change_control = control_mild_bonus
				change_prosperity = prosperity_mild_bonus
				add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_bri_most_esteemed_university_modifier years = -1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = royal_society }
				add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_end_the_french_conflict = {
		icon = medieval_military
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_hundred_years_war }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 150
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = {
				is_situation_active = situation:hundred_years_war
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_modifier = victory_in_the_hyw_modifier
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						c:FRA = {
							exists = yes
							is_subject_of = root
						}
					}
					c:FRA = {
						add_opinion = {
							modifier = oe_wp35_bri_grateful_to_britain
							target = root
						}
						add_trust_equilibrium = {
							target = root
							modifier = oe_wp35_bri_trust_grateful_to_britain
						}
					}
					add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
					add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
					add_army_tradition = army_tradition_severe_bonus
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						c:FRA = {
							exists = no
						}
					}
					add_prestige = prestige_extreme_bonus
					add_legitimacy = legitimacy_extreme_bonus
					add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
				}
				else = {
					add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
					add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_wp35_bri_recovering_prestige_modifier
						years = 20
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
				add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_wp35_bri_recovering_prestige_modifier
					years = 20
				}
				add_army_tradition = army_tradition_mild_bonus
			}
			
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_develop_british_identity = {
		icon = cultural_acceptance_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_end_the_french_conflict }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				stability >= 35
				legitimacy >= 60
				prestige >= 30
				region:great_britain_region = {
					any_location_in_region = {
						OR = {
							owner ?= root
							owner ?= {
								is_subject_of = root
								NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
							}
						}
						count >= 150
					}
				}
				region:ireland_region = {
					any_location_in_region = {
						OR = {
							owner ?= root
							owner ?= {
								is_subject_of = root
								NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
							}
						}
						count >= 35
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_tolerated_culture = culture:irish
					has_accepted_culture = culture:irish
				}
				OR = {
					has_tolerated_culture = culture:scottish
					has_accepted_culture = culture:scottish
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
				stability >= 50
				legitimacy >= 60
				prestige >= 40
				region:great_britain_region = {
					any_location_in_region = {
						OR = {
							owner ?= root
							owner ?= {
								is_subject_of = root
								NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
							}
						}
						count >= 170
					}
				}

				region:ireland_region = {
					any_location_in_region = {
						OR = {
							owner ?= root
							owner ?= {
								is_subject_of = root
								NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
							}
						}
						count >= 50
					}
				}
				OR = {
					has_tolerated_culture = culture:irish
					has_accepted_culture = culture:irish
				}
				OR = {
					has_tolerated_culture = culture:scottish
					has_accepted_culture = culture:scottish
				}

			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
			add_stability = stability_weak_bonus

			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						c:IRE ?= {
							is_subject_of = root
						}
						region:ireland_region = {
							any_location_in_region = {
								owner ?= root
								count >= 50
							}
						}
					}
					has_tolerated_culture = culture:irish
				}
				add_accepted_culture = culture:irish
			}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_wp35_bri_unified_british_identity_modifier
					years = -1
					mode = add
				}
			if = {
				limit = { has_tolerated_culture = culture:scottish }
				add_accepted_culture = culture:scottish
			}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_the_royal_court = {
		icon = court_accounting
		requires = {  }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {

					has_any_active_disaster = yes
				}
				legitimacy >= 85

					OR = {
						adm > 60
						dip > 60
						mil > 60
					}
				}
				any_cabinet_character ?= {
					OR = {
						adm >= {
							value = root.ruler_or_regent.adm
							multiply = 0.8
							min = 50
						}
						dip >= {
							value = root.ruler_or_regent.dip
							multiply = 0.8
							min = 50
						}
						mil >= {
							value = root.ruler_or_regent.mil
							multiply = 0.8
							min = 50
						}
					}
				}
				any_cabinet_character ?= {
					modifier:is_head_of_cabinet = yes
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
				NOT = {
					has_any_active_disaster = yes
				}
				legitimacy >= 90
				ruler = {
					OR = {
						AND = { adm > 60 dip > 60 }
						AND = { adm > 60 mil > 60 }
						AND = { dip > 60 mil > 60 }
					}
				}
				any_cabinet_character ?= {
					OR = {
						adm >= {
							value = root.ruler_or_regent.adm
							multiply = 0.8
							min = 50
						}
						dip >= {
							value = root.ruler_or_regent.dip
							multiply = 0.8
							min = 50
						}
						mil >= {
							value = root.ruler_or_regent.mil
							multiply = 0.8
							min = 50
						}
					}
				}
				any_cabinet_character ?= {
					modifier:is_head_of_cabinet = yes
				}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_wp35_bri_the_royal_court_modifier
				years = 20
			}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_mainland_alliances = {
		icon = diplomatic_influence
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_hundred_years_war oe_wp35_bri_the_royal_court }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				OR = {
					is_hegemon = yes
					any_known_country = {
						count >= 2
						is_allied_with = { target = root }
						OR = {
							tag = POR
							total_development >= 1500
						}
						capital.continent = root.capital.continent
						this_opinion_of_prev >= 75
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
				OR = {
					is_hegemon = yes
					any_known_country = {
							count >= 2
							is_allied_with = { target = root }
							OR = {
									tag = POR
									total_development >= 2000
							}
							capital.continent = root.capital.continent
							this_opinion_of_prev >= 150
					}
				}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = c:POR
					has_trust = { modifier = trust_treaty_of_windsor target = c:POR }
				}
				add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					root = {
						is_hegemon = yes
					}
				}
				add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
			}
			else = {
				add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
				every_known_country = {
					limit = {
							is_allied_with = { target = root }
							OR = {
									tag = POR
									total_development >= 2000
							}
							capital.continent = root.capital.continent
							this_opinion_of_prev >= 150
					}
					add_trust_equilibrium_mutual_effect = {
							target = root
							modifier = oe_wp35_bri_trust_mainland_alliance
					}
					root = {
							add_favors = {
									target = prev
									value = 10
							}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

										area = area:holland_area
										area = area:wallonia_area
								}
						}
					}
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = subject_oe_wp35_bri_owns_45_low_countries_tt
						any_subject_or_below = {
								NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
								any_owned_location = {
										count >= 45
										OR = {
												area = area:brabant_area
												area = area:flanders_area
												area = area:friesland_area
												area = area:holland_area
												area = area:wallonia_area
										}
								}
						}
					}
				
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = ally_oe_wp35_bri_owns_45_low_countries_tt
						any_known_country = {
								is_allied_with = { target = root }
								capital = {
										OR = {
												area = area:brabant_area
												area = area:flanders_area
												area = area:friesland_area
												area = area:holland_area
												area = area:wallonia_area
										}
								}
								OR = {
										culture = culture:low_franconian 
										culture = culture:frisian
										culture = culture:walloon
								}
								any_owned_location = {
										count >= 45
										OR = {
												area = area:brabant_area
												area = area:flanders_area
												area = area:friesland_area
												area = area:holland_area
												area = area:wallonia_area
										}
								}
						}
					}
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = oe_wp35_bri_lowlands_economic_hegemon_tt
						current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
						is_hegemon_type = hegemony:economic_hegemon
					}
				}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = c:NED
					has_trust = { modifier = trust_treaty_of_nonsuch target = c:NED }
				}
				add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
				add_navy_tradition = navy_tradition_mild_bonus
			}
			if = {
					limit = {
							any_known_country = {
									is_allied_with = { target = root }
									capital = {
											OR = {
													area = area:brabant_area
													area = area:flanders_area
													area = area:friesland_area
													area = area:holland_area
													area = area:wallonia_area
											}
									}
									OR = {
											culture = culture:low_franconian
											culture = culture:frisian
											culture = culture:walloon
									}
									any_owned_location = {
											count >= 45
											OR = {
													area = area:brabant_area
													area = area:flanders_area
													area = area:friesland_area
													area = area:holland_area
													area = area:wallonia_area
											}
									}
							}
					}
					every_known_country = {
							limit = {
									is_allied_with = { target = root }
									capital = {
											OR = {
													area = area:brabant_area
													area = area:flanders_area
													area = area:friesland_area
													area = area:holland_area
													area = area:wallonia_area
											}
									}
									OR = {
											culture = culture:low_franconian
											culture = culture:frisian
											culture = culture:walloon
									}
									any_owned_location = {
											count >= 45
											OR = {
													area = area:brabant_area
													area = area:flanders_area
													area = area:friesland_area
													area = area:holland_area
													area = area:wallonia_area
											}
									}
							}
							add_opinion = {
									target = root
									modifier = oe_wp35_bri_opinion_lowlands_trade_partners
							}
							root = {
									add_opinion = {
											target = prev
											modifier = oe_wp35_bri_opinion_lowlands_trade_partners
									}
							}
							add_country_modifier = {
									modifier = oe_wp35_bri_lowlands_trade_partners_modifier
									years = 20
									mode = add_and_extend
							}
							root = {
									add_country_modifier = {
											modifier = oe_wp35_bri_lowlands_trade_partners_modifier
											years = 20
											mode = add_and_extend
									}
							}
					}
			}
			else = {
					if = {
							limit = {
									NOT = { has_accepted_culture = culture:low_franconian }
							}
							add_accepted_culture = culture:low_franconian
					}
					add_country_modifier = {
							modifier = oe_wp35_bri_integrated_lowlands_modifier
							years = -1
							mode = add_and_extend
					}
			}
		}
	}

			}
		}

	oe_wp35_bri_found_the_royal_navy = {
		icon = ship_building_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_abolish_villeinage }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 150
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				navy_size >= 35
				num_of_ports >= 15
			}
			trigger_else = {
				navy_size >= 60
				num_of_ports >= 20
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_navy_tradition = navy_tradition_extreme_bonus

					modifier = oe_wp35_bri_sailor_surge_modifier
					years = modifier_duration_years_normal
				}

			create_character = {
        adm = { 50 70 }
        dip = { 50 70 }
        mil = { 50 70 }
        trait_category = explorer
      }

			add_country_modifier = {
        modifier = oe_wp35_bri_exploration_spirit_modifier
        years = 25
    	}
		}
		on_persistent_completion = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_renewal_tt
			root = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						location:malta.owner ?= {
							this != root
							NOT = {
								is_subject_or_below_of = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
					add_casus_belli = {
							target = location:malta.owner  
							type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent  
							province = location:malta.province              
							years = -1
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						location:candia.owner ?= {
							this != root
							NOT = {
								is_subject_or_below_of = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
					add_casus_belli = {
							target = location:candia.owner
							type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent

				}
				if = {

						location:nicosia_cyp.owner ?= {
							this != root
							NOT = {
								is_subject_or_below_of = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
					add_casus_belli = {
							target = location:nicosia_cyp.owner
							type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent 
							province = location:nicosia_cyp.province
							years = -1
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						location:ciudadela_de_menorca.owner ?= {
							this != root
							NOT = {
								is_subject_or_below_of = ROOT
							}
						}
					}
					add_casus_belli = {
							target = location:ciudadela_de_menorca.owner

	oe_wp35_bri_colonize_canada = {
		icon = ship_building_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_discover_the_americas }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				OR = {
					has_discovered_area = area:newfoundland_area
					has_discovered_area = area:labrador_area
					has_discovered_area = area:acadia_area
					has_discovered_area = area:quebec_area
					has_discovered_area = area:new_brunswick_area
				}
				region:canada_region = {
					any_location_in_region = {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = root
								is_subject_or_below_of = root
							}
						}
						count >= 40
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
					OR = {
						has_discovered_area = area:newfoundland_area
						has_discovered_area = area:labrador_area
						has_discovered_area = area:acadia_area
						has_discovered_area = area:quebec_area
						has_discovered_area = area:new_brunswick_area
					}
					region:canada_region = {
						any_location_in_region = {
								count >= 60
								owner ?= {
										OR = {
												this = root
												is_subject_or_below_of = root
										}
								}
						}
					}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_bri_established_shipping_lanes_modifier years = 25 }
		}
	}

		ai_will_do = {
			value = 150
		}
		enabled = {
				has_discovered_area = area:goringhaikona_area
		}
		on_completion = {
				if = {
						limit = {
								location:goringhaikona = {
										is_ownable = yes
										NOT = { has_owner = yes }
								}
						}
						location:goringhaikona = {
								change_location_owner = root
								add_core = root
						}
				}
				else = {
						area:goringhaikona_area = {
								random_location_in_area = {
										limit = {
												is_ownable = yes
												NOT = { has_owner = yes }
												is_coastal = yes
										}
										change_location_owner = root
										add_core = root
								}
						}
				}
		}
	}

		}

		}
		on_persistent_completion = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_renewal_tt

					years = -1
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					location:berune.owner ?= {
						this != root
						NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root }
					}
				}
				add_casus_belli = {
					target = location:berune.owner
					type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent
					province = location:berune.province
					years = -1
				}
			}
			if = {

					province = location:ternate.province

	oe_wp35_bri_trade_company_charter = {
		icon = route_to_the_indies_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_east_indies_company }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 150
		}
		
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_wp35_bri_trade_company_charter_can_build_tt
				sub_continent:south_asia = {
					any_location_in_sub_continent = {
						is_coastal = yes
						OR = {
							owner ?= root
							owner ?= {
								is_subject_of = root
								NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				has_advance = trade_companies_advance
				total_effective_building_levels:trade_company_headquarters < 1
				NOT = { has_variable = building_trade_hq }
				num_relations_above_limit <= 0
			}
		}
		
		on_completion = {
			add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus

			sub_continent:south_asia = {
				ordered_location_in_sub_continent = {
					limit = {
						is_coastal = yes
						owner ?= {
							is_subject_of = root
							NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
						}
					}
					order_by = population
					max = 1
					save_scope_as = eic_hq_location
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:eic_hq_location }
				custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_trade_company_charter_tt
				scope:eic_hq_location = {
					construct_building = {
						building_type = building_type:trade_company_headquarters
						owner = root
						instant = yes
						cost_multiplier = 0
						cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
					}
				}
				trigger_event_silently = { id = oe_wp35_bri.2 days = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = flavor_eng.34 days = 5 }
			}
			else = {
				custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_trade_company_charter_direct_tt
				add_gold = oe_wp35_bri_gold_reward_medium
			}
		}
		on_persistent_completion = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_unlock_landholding_tt
			set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_landholding_unlocked
		}
	}

														type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent

	oe_wp35_bri_conquer_bengal = {
		icon = ship_building_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_east_indies_company }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 150
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				region:bengal_region = {
					any_location_in_region = {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = root
								AND = {
									is_subject_or_below_of = root
									NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
								}
							}
						}
						count >= 25
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
					region:bengal_region = {
							any_location_in_region = {
									count >= 70
									custom_tooltip = {
										text = oe_wp35_bri_own_location_in_bengal_tt
										owner ?= {
												OR = {
														this = root
														AND = {
																is_subject_or_below_of = root
																NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
														}
												}
										}
									}
							}
					}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_wp35_bri_growing_east_indian_trade_modifier
				years = 25
			}
		}
		on_persistent_completion = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_renewal_tt
			if = {
					limit = {
							any_subject = {
									has_variable = oe_wp35_is_british_india
							}
					}

					random_subject = {
							limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_is_british_india }
							save_scope_as = oe_wp35_bri_india
					}
					
					custom_tooltip = {
						region:bengal_region = {
								every_location_in_region = {
										limit = {
												has_owner = yes
												owner != root
												owner = { NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root } }
										}
										scope:oe_wp35_bri_india = {
												add_casus_belli = {
														target = prev.owner
														type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent
														province = prev.province
														years = -1
												}
										}
								}
						}
						
						text = oe_wp35_bri_india_bengal_cb_tt
					}
			}
			else = {
				custom_tooltip = {
						region:bengal_region = {
								every_location_in_region = {
										limit = {
												has_owner = yes
												owner != root
												owner = { NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = root } }
										}
										root = {
												add_casus_belli = {
														target = prev.owner
														type = casus_belli:cb_oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent
														province = prev.province
														years = -1
												}
										}
								}
						}
						
						text = oe_wp35_bri_britain_bengal_cb_tt
					}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_unlock_securing_tt
			set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_securing_unlocked
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						situation:oe_wp35_eic_situation = { situation_is_active = yes }
					}
					situation:oe_wp35_eic_situation = { set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_securing }
				}
			}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_masters_of_india = {
		icon = ship_building_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_take_west_indian_coast oe_wp35_bri_push_into_inland_india oe_wp35_bri_conquer_bengal }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				sub_continent:south_asia = {
					any_location_in_sub_continent = {
						owner ?= {
							OR = {
								this = root
								AND = {
									is_subject_or_below_of = root
									NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
								}
							}
						}
						count >= 400
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
					sub_continent:south_asia = {
							any_location_in_sub_continent = {
									count >= 600
									custom_tooltip = {
										text = oe_wp35_bri_own_location_in_india_tt
										owner ?= {
												OR = {
														this = root
														AND = {
																is_subject_or_below_of = root
																NOT = { is_subject_type = tributary }
														}
												}
										}
									}
							}
					}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_wp35_bri_masters_of_india_modifier
					years = -1
			}
		}
		on_persistent_completion = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_crown_rule_mission_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_crown_rule
				oe_wp35_bri_refresh_crown_rule = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						situation:oe_wp35_eic_situation = { situation_is_active = yes }
					}
					end_situation = {
						situation = situation:oe_wp35_eic_situation
						outcome = "oe_wp35_eic_situation_crown_rule"
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	

	oe_wp35_bri_war_of_the_roses = {
		icon = medieval_military
		requires = { }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
				OR = {
					tag = ENG
					tag = GBR
				}
				OR = {
						custom_tooltip = {
								text = oe_wp35_bri_war_of_the_roses_disaster_tt
								has_variable = had_war_of_the_roses_disaster
						}
						AND = {
							current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
							NOT = { has_variable = has_had_war_of_the_roses_disaster }
						}
				}
				
				custom_tooltip = {
						text = oe_wp35_bri_war_of_roses_info_tt
						always = yes 
				}
		}
		on_completion = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = yorkist_tradition }
				add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			}
			if = {
					limit = { has_variable = had_war_of_the_roses_disaster }
					
					if = {
							limit = { stability < 50 }
							add_stability = stability_severe_bonus
					}
					else = {
							add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
					}
					
					add_country_modifier = {
							modifier = oe_wp35_bri_a_house_united_modifier
							years = 20
					}
			}
			else = {
					if = {
							limit = { government_type = government_type:monarchy }
							
							add_country_modifier = {
									modifier = oe_wp35_bri_dynastic_power_modifier
									years = 25
							}

							ruler = {
									add_character_modifier = {
											modifier = oe_wp35_bri_dynastic_security_modifier
											years = 25
									}
							}
					}
					else = {
							add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
					}
			}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_handle_the_reformation = {
		icon = cultural_acceptance_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_war_of_the_roses }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
				current_age_or_later = { age = age_4_reformation }
				
				OR = {
						NOT = { religion = religion:catholic }
						has_had_situation = { situation = situation:council_of_trent }
						AND = {
								religion = religion:catholic
								current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism } 
						}
				}
		}
		on_completion = {
					if = {
							limit = {
									religion = religion:catholic
									religion:lutheran = { is_religion_enabled = yes }
							}
							custom_tooltip = {
									text = oe_wp35_bri_act_of_supremacy_hint_tt
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = flavor_eng.7 }
							}
					}

				if = {
						limit = {
								NOT = { religion ?= { group = religion_group:christian } }
						}
						
						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_a_new_religious_destiny_modifier
								years = 20						}
				}
				
				else_if = {
						limit = {
								religion ?= { group = religion_group:christian }
								NOT = { religion = religion:catholic }
								NOT = { is_protestant = yes }
								NOT = { religion = religion:anglican }
						}
						
						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_absent_from_the_reformation_modifier
								years = 20						}
				}
				
				else_if = {
						limit = {
								religion = religion:catholic
								has_had_situation = { situation = situation:council_of_trent }
						}

						add_religious_influence = religious_influence_extreme_bonus

						c:PAP ?= {
								add_opinion = {
										target = root
										modifier = oe_wp35_bri_papal_support
								}
						}

						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_loyalty_to_the_pope_modifier
								years = 25						}
				}

				else_if = {
						limit = {
								religion = religion:catholic
								NOT = { current_age = age_4_reformation }
						}

						add_religious_influence = religious_influence_extreme_bonus
				}
				
				else_if = {
						limit = { is_protestant = yes }
						
						add_religious_influence = religious_influence_ultimate_bonus
						
						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_one_state_one_church_modifier
								years = 25						}
				}
				
				else_if = {
						limit = { religion = religion:anglican }
						
						add_religious_influence = religious_influence_ultimate_bonus
						
						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_head_of_anglican_church_modifier
								years = 25						}
				}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_piety_of_the_state = {
		icon = cultural_acceptance_advance
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_handle_the_reformation }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				num_reforms >= 4
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_reform = government_reform:administration_of_clerical_lands
						OR = {
							NOT = { "estate_power(estate_type:clergy_estate)" > 0 }
							"estate_power(estate_type:clergy_estate)" < 0.50
						}
					}
					AND = {
						NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:administration_of_clerical_lands }
						OR = {
							any_owned_location = {
								OR = {
									has_building = building_type:cathedral
									has_building = building_type:temple
								}
								count >= 30
							}
							estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate >= 0.5
						}
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
					num_reforms >= 4
					OR = {
							AND = {
									has_reform = government_reform:administration_of_clerical_lands
									OR = {
											NOT = { "estate_power(estate_type:clergy_estate)" > 0 }
											"estate_power(estate_type:clergy_estate)" < 0.50
									}
							}
							AND = {
									NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:administration_of_clerical_lands }
									OR = {
										any_owned_location = {
												OR = {
														has_building = building_type:cathedral
														has_building = building_type:temple
												}
												count >= 60
										}
										estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate >= 0.6
									}
							}
					}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_wp35_bri_anglican_reform_progress_modifier
					years = -1
				}
				
				if = {
						limit = {
								OR = {
										is_protestant = yes
										religion = religion:anglican
										religion = religion:hussite
								}
						}
						
						add_religious_influence = religious_influence_extreme_bonus
				}
				else = {
						add_country_modifier = {
							modifier = oe_wp35_bri_religious_stability_modifier
							years = -1						}
					
						if = {
								limit = { religion ?= { group = religion_group:christian } }				
								if = {
										limit = { religion = religion:catholic }
										add_religious_influence = religious_influence_severe_bonus
								}
								else_if = {
										limit = { religion = religion:orthodox }
										add_religious_influence = religious_influence_mild_bonus
								}
						}
				}
				
				if = {
						limit = {
								has_reform = government_reform:administration_of_clerical_lands
						}
						
						add_country_modifier = {
							modifier = oe_wp35_bri_anglican_state_church_modifier
							years = -1						}
						
						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_clergy_land_confiscation_modifier
								years = -1						}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
								OR = {
										is_protestant = yes
										religion = religion:anglican
										religion = religion:hussite
								}
						}
						
						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_clergy_approval_anglican_settlement_modifier
								years = -1						}
					}
					else = {					
						add_country_modifier = {
								modifier = oe_wp35_bri_conciliarism_of_churches_modifier
								years = -1						}
					}
						
				}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_strengthen_the_crown = {
		icon = government_reforms
		requires = { }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 150
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				NOT = {
					any_rebel = {
						rebel_progress >= 0.2
					}
				}
				legitimacy >= 85
				any_subject = {
					liberty_desire >= 50
					count < 1
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism } } }
					estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate >= 0.45
					estate_satisfaction:burghers_estate >= 0.40
					estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate >= 0.45
					estate_satisfaction:peasants_estate >= 0.45
				}
				trigger_else = {
					average_control_in_home_region >= 0.50
					"estate_power(estate_type:crown_estate)" >= 0.33
				}
			}
			trigger_else = {
				NOT = {
					any_rebel = {
						rebel_progress >= 0.2
					}
				}
				legitimacy >= 90
				any_subject = {
					liberty_desire >= 20
					count < 1
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { current_age_or_later = { age = age_5_absolutism } } }
					estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate >= 0.60
					estate_satisfaction:burghers_estate >= 0.60
					estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate >= 0.60
					estate_satisfaction:peasants_estate >= 0.60
				}
				trigger_else = {
					average_control_in_home_region >= 0.60
					"estate_power(estate_type:crown_estate)" >= 0.40
				}
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_wp35_bri_strong_crown_modifier
				years = 20
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_wp35_bri_ecw_tension_tt
				set_variable = { name = english_civil_war_chance_variable value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = successful_court_and_country_variable }
				add_legitimacy = legitimacy_severe_bonus
				add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
			}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_acts_of_the_parliament = {
		icon = government_reforms
		requires = { }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_ai = yes }
				has_parliament = yes
				estate_satisfaction:burghers_estate >= 0.50
				stability >= 50
			}
			trigger_else = {
			  estate_satisfaction:burghers_estate >= 0.70
				has_parliament = yes
				stability >= 50
				months_since_last_parliament_called <= 24
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
			add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_wp35_bri_strong_burghers_modifier
				years = 20
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_wp35_bri_ecw_tension_tt
				set_variable = { name = english_civil_war_chance_variable value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						has_reform = government_reform:petition_of_rights
						has_variable = representative_government
					}
				}
				add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
			}
		}
	}

	oe_wp35_bri_the_three_kingdoms_wars = {
		icon = medieval_military
		requires = { oe_wp35_bri_strengthen_the_crown oe_wp35_bri_acts_of_the_parliament }
		duration = 0
		ai_will_do = {
			value = 100
		}
		enabled = {
			OR = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = oe_wp35_bri_three_kingdoms_wars_info_tt
					has_variable = concluded_ecw_variable
				}
				current_age_or_later = { age = age_6_revolutions }
			}
		}
		on_completion = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = concluded_ecw_variable
				}
				add_prestige = prestige_extreme_bonus
				add_legitimacy = legitimacy_severe_bonus
				add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_wp35_bri_restored_order_modifier
					years = 20
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
				add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
				add_army_tradition = army_tradition_severe_bonus
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_wp35_bri_weathered_absolutism_modifier
					years = 20
				}
			}

			
		}
	}

}
